title: Suffering Place?
content: Has anyone been to a really dark, underground cavern civilization, but there was so much suffering? Like internment camps look like heaven compared to this place? Nanking level or more. Just so much rot and sickness and hatred and torture... If so, any idea what this place is? A depository for negative emotions maybe? Like when tragedy happens the excess negative feelings get sucked here? I only saw it properly once. But I've felt the terror before.
